title: android_ui MCP server
objective: Expose AndroidUi's eight element-targeted methods as FastMCP stdio tools with the CLI's error guarantees, plus a label-only workout_app Firebase flow script.
acceptance_criteria: The in-process client lists exactly dump, find, tap, type_into, type_into_field, wait_for, scroll_to, focus (test_mcp_server.py)
tap with 0 and >1 matches returns isError naming the query and count (test_mcp_server.py)
type_into / type_into_field on an unchanged field return isError with before/after length and never the typed text (test_mcp_server.py, test_mcp_target.py)
No serial with 2 devices returns isError listing both; display=self with no virtual display returns isError and creates none (test_mcp_target.py)
verifier: python_pkg/android_ui/tests under pytest --cov-branch, plus a stdio smoke client
